title: Composition of termwise tensor counits on a complex
statement: Fix derived categories on all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let W be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open of W, K a complex of modules on U, and P = overEquiv(U)(K). Let i:T′→T and s:T→U be scheme morphisms. Write c(i,s) for the pinned derived composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], η for picardTermwiseCounit, P_s for the termwise tensor pullback of P along s, and w:P_(i;s)≅i*(P_s) for picardTermwiseModelRestrictionIso [def-sc-picard-termwise-models]. Then c(i,s).inv_(QP);Li*(η_s(P));η_i(P_s) = η_(i;s)(P);Q(w.hom). No perfectness or invertibility assumption on K is imposed. Derived pullbacks are those of [def-pc-derived-pullback].

source.place: Tags 06YJ and 0D5S; the counit equation for composition, expanded through the homotopy quotient

proof.text: Evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift identity for the pinned composition comparison at the homotopy class of P, using Mathlib Functor.leftDerived_fac_app.

Expand picardTermwiseCounit through the quotient of complexes; all quotient comparison components are identities, and functors preserve identity maps. Identify the inverse tensorPullbackCompositionIso with the conjugate of pushforwardComp and map that comparison to homotopy complexes. This identifies the remaining underived comparison with the inverse of picardTermwiseModelRestrictionIso.
Use Iso.inv_comp_eq to cancel the derived composition comparison, substitute the proved factorization, and cancel b.hom followed by b.inv using Functor.map_comp. No counit is inverted or canceled.

proof_origin.description: Direct evaluation of the pinned left-derived-lift equation, transport through the homotopy quotient, and cancellation of the two comparison isomorphisms. No new unproved factorization theorem.

theorem picard_termwise_counit_composition
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (U : W.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme) :
    let c : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
        derivedPullback g ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅ derivedPullback (f ≫ g) :=
      fun f g ↦ Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) f g
    let P := ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K
    (c i s).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (derivedPullback i).map ((picardTermwiseCounit s).app P) ≫
          (picardTermwiseCounit i).app (picardTermwiseModel W U K s) =
      (picardTermwiseCounit (i ≫ s)).app P ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (picardTermwiseModelRestrictionIso W U K i s (i ≫ s) rfl).hom
